name: Sakuraba Katsumi
source:
Kinpou Institutute Senior High School 2nd Year.
Star Sign: Taurus
He's a member of the photography club and the neighbor and childhood friend of the protagonist. His parents run the "Sakura Bakery".
His older sister who helped raise him disappeared seven years ago and it has weighed heavily on his mind ever since.
Despite his bad mouth he has a bright, sociable personality.
